headline: Going Commando's USA v1.01 reaches 5.60% matched code
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 matched code rose from 4.44% to 5.60%, with 2,881 of 9,100 entries reported finished, including original assembly. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. New batches cover shared game state and level routines.
highlights: #169 corrects its batch count to 157 functions, rather than the earlier claim of 211.
#170 adds 106 game-function matches for USA v1.01.
#167 adds 30 shared functions for state resets, transfers and UI vectors.
#168 adds 30 functions and corrects three function boundaries, retaining assembly prefixes.
#171 refreshes the progress catalogue, reducing its total from 9,101 to 9,100 entries.
